species.name: Crappie
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 10–18 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–22 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
East wind at 8 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
